internalAudits.title: Internal Audits
internalAudits.description: Internal audit schedule, execution, and findings. Required by NIS2 Art. 21 effectiveness assessment.
internalAudits.helpText: Schedule and document internal audits of your cybersecurity measures. Record scope, findings, and corrective actions. NIS2 requires regular assessment of whether security measures are effective.
internalAudits.empty: No internal audits planned yet. Schedule your first audit.
internalAudits.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this audit?

fieldDescriptions.title: Name of this internal audit (e.g., 'Q2 Access Control Audit', 'Annual NIS2 Compliance Review').
fieldDescriptions.auditArea: Security domain or control area being audited (e.g., access control, incident response, supply chain).
fieldDescriptions.scope: Define the boundaries of this audit: which systems, processes, departments, or controls are included.
fieldDescriptions.status: Current audit status: planned, in progress, completed, or cancelled.
fieldDescriptions.scheduledDate: Date when this audit is planned to begin.
fieldDescriptions.completedAt: Date when all audit activities and the final report were completed.
fieldDescriptions.auditorName: Name of the internal auditor or audit team lead conducting this assessment.
